transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. Thank you for coming in today. What brings you to the clinic?

Hello, Doctor. Well, I'm here because... honestly, for nearly two years now, I’ve been absolutely sure that our contractor and some of the people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts to try and explain it, and they always have all these excuses, but... I just know what's going on.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people around you couldn't hear or see?

No, no I haven't. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. I mean... I know what you're asking, but no, it's nothing like that. Everything I'm seeing and hearing is really happening right in front of me. I just pay attention to what they're actually doing to my house.

When your husband shows you those receipts and explanations from the contractor, even though you don't believe them, is there any small part of you that wonders if you might possibly be mistaken about what's happening?

No, not really. I mean, I look at the receipts he shows me, but... no. Like I said a minute ago, it's been nearly two years of this. I am absolutely sure that the contractor and those people on my block are quietly working together to cheat us. 

They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose, and it just doesn't matter how many pieces of paper my husband shows me or how many excuses they give him. I know what I know, and I'm not mistaken about what they're doing.

If you somehow found out tomorrow that the contractor and your neighbors were actually not working together against you, how would you feel about that? Would that be possible in your mind, or do you think that's just not something that could ever be true?

Well, honestly, I just don't think that's something that could ever be true. 

Like I've been telling you, it's been two whole years of this. I know what I see. The contractor and those folks on my block are working together to cheat us, and they are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. I know my husband has all those receipts, and I know they have an excuse for everything under the sun, but... if someone told me tomorrow that it wasn't happening, I just wouldn't believe them. 

Because it is happening. I'm living it, so it's just not possible in my mind that it's not true.

Besides this situation with the contractor and your neighbors working together to cheat you with the kitchen, are there other things that you're convinced are happening to you or around you that other people don't seem to believe or understand?

No, no nothing like that. It's really just this whole mess with the house. 

I mean... my life is pretty quiet otherwise. I do my errands, mind my own business, and everything else is just perfectly normal. It's only this specific situation with the kitchen and those people on my block. I don't have any other... well, whatever you'd call it. There's nothing else going on that people don't understand, just this one thing they're doing to us.

When you say the contractor and your neighbors are keeping your kitchen half-wrong on purpose, do you think they're doing this because they want your money, or is there something else motivating them to deliberately sabotage your kitchen?

Well, I'm not entirely sure what their main reason is. I mean, money is usually why people cheat you, so I suppose they're getting something out of it financially. But... I don't know if there's something else behind it. 

I haven't really figured out exactly why they're so determined to keep my kitchen messed up. I just know for a fact that they are doing it. As for their exact motivation, or what they get out of dragging this on for two years... I just don't know.

When you think about this situation with the contractor and your neighbors working together for two years to keep your kitchen wrong on purpose, does that seem like a reasonable thing for them to do? I mean, does it make sense to you that they would go to all that trouble and spend all that time on this?

Well, honestly... no, it doesn't make a lot of sense to me. I mean, when you say it like that, it does seem like a whole lot of trouble for them to go through. 

I ask myself that same question sometimes. Why spend two whole years doing this to my kitchen? It's not reasonable at all. But... just because I don't understand why they'd go to all that effort doesn't change the fact that they are doing it. I don't have the answers for why they act the way they do, I just know what I'm living with every single day.

If I told you that I've reviewed everything you've described, and from an objective standpoint there's no evidence that the contractor and your neighbors are actually working together against you, would you consider that I might have a point, or would you still be completely certain that your belief is correct?

I hear what you're saying, Doctor, but... no, I wouldn't think you have a point. I am completely certain. 

I mean, that's really why I'm here talking to you. For nearly two years now, I've been absolutely sure that the contractor and some of the people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. It really doesn't matter how many receipts my husband shows me, or... or how many excuses those people give us. I know what's happening right in front of me. So, yes, I am entirely sure that I'm right about this.

I understand you're completely certain about what's happening. But let me ask you this: Is there any possibility, however small, that your mind might be playing tricks on you and creating connections between things that aren't actually connected? Or do you feel certain that's not what's happening here?

No, I don't think my mind is playing tricks on me at all. I'm absolutely certain that's not what's happening. 

Like I said, I'm here because for nearly two years now, I've been completely sure that the contractor and some of the people on my block are quietly working together to cheat us. They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. It doesn't matter how many receipts my husband shows me or how many excuses they give us. I know what's going on, and it's not my imagination.

Let me ask you something different: If you were to imagine yourself in my shoes as a doctor, and you were listening to someone describe exactly what you've described to me, would you think that person definitely has a real conspiracy against them, or might you wonder if something else could be going on in their mind?

Well... if I were in your shoes, just listening to someone talk, I suppose I might wonder if something else was going on. I know how it must sound to a doctor. 

But I'm not the one just listening to a story, I'm the one living it. And like I keep saying, for nearly two years now, I have been absolutely sure that the contractor and some of the people on my block are quietly working together to cheat us. They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband tries to show me the receipts, and those people give us all their excuses, but none of that changes what they're actually doing. 

So, I understand why you would ask that from your side of the desk, but I know what's really happening.

You mentioned that if you were in my shoes, you might wonder if something else was going on. Given that you can see how this situation might sound unusual or hard to believe to an outside observer, do you think there's any chance you could be wrong about the contractor and neighbors working together, even though right now you feel completely sure you're right?

No, Doctor, I really don't. 

I know I keep saying the exact same thing to you, but... well, I'm here because for nearly two years now, I've been absolutely sure that the contractor and some of the people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. They are keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. It just doesn't matter how many receipts my husband tries to show me, or... or how many excuses they all give us. I know what they are doing. 

So, no, even though I know how it sounds to an outsider, I don't think there is any chance I'm wrong about them.
